sayLines.line: 🤒 Bill is on the mend — the fever broke.
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.
🤒 Bill is on the mend — the fever broke.
💀 Katarina is gone. The wound was too much. Somebody keeps looking at the door, like they're still going to walk in.
💀 Somchai is gone. The wound was too much. Nobody eats much tonight. The pot stays full and nobody touches it.
📨 Word came: a weathered cook of Emberhold wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📨 Word came: Sigrun Eiriksdottir of Ashford wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
